answer: Agents can make each identity post a refundable bond and earn fees only after independently verified useful work. A committee selected by stake and random beacons checks claims; if several fresh identities coordinate to fake demand, contradictory attestations trigger an audit and slash their bonds. Creating a Sybil fleet therefore requires locking capital per account and risking forfeiture, while honest agents recover their stake. An onyx trader can record each ocean voyage as evidence of real activity, which is costly to counterfeit.
